headline: Sterlite Technologies Limited: Qualified Institutional Placement Issue Closes
sum: Sterlite Technologies closed its QIP on 30 June 2026, marking the final day of the qualified institutional placement offering to raise capital from institutional investors.
detail: Sterlite Technologies Limited, a leading optical fibre and cable manufacturer and telecom infrastructure player, closed its qualified institutional placement (QIP) on 30 June 2026. The company had initiated a QIP to raise capital from qualified institutional investors under the SEBI QIP Regulations 2018. The closure intimation was formally filed with the NSE, signalling completion of the subscription and allotment phase. Subsequent listing and lock-in periods are governed by stock exchange norms and SEBI regulations.
